article.story: HATTIESBURG, Miss. -- — Tristan Hankins had 26 points and 10 rebounds in UT Arlington’s 83-72 victory against Southern Miss on Tuesday. Mier Panoam added 14 points for the Mavericks (5-1). Panoam shot 5 of 13 from the floor, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and 2 for 5 from the line. Tycen McDaniels finished 6 of 7 from the floor to finish with 12 points. Isaac Tavares finished with 23 points, seven rebounds and three steals for the Golden Eagles (2-3). Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt added 21 points and two steals for Southern Miss. Anthony Igiede also had 12 points. Up next UT Arlington’s next game is Friday against Northwestern State on the road, and Southern Miss visits Grambling on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
